segments.title: 第165章 李珞,你欺負我
segments.content:
Reigniting the Verdant Years, Chapter 165: Li Luo, You're Bullying Me

At seven in the morning, the early self-study session began.

All the teachers and students of the school were sitting in their classrooms, listening to the school leaders speak over the broadcast, explaining the origin, concept, and development of the New Year's Day gala.

The speech dragged on until seven-thirty, when the principal finally announced that the day's activities would officially begin.

Each class had half an hour to prepare. At eight o'clock, the morning's class mini-games could commence.

In Class Eight's classroom, Li Luo had already instructed Xiuxiu during last night's evening self-study session to mobilize the entire class to move the desks and chairs to the walls and by the windows, forming a circle and leaving the center of the room empty.

Now, as soon as it hit seven-thirty, after the principal finished speaking, Li Luo stood up at Kong Junxiang's signal and called out, "Students who brought instruments, bring your chairs out and line them up here in front of the teacher's podium."

"Our time in the morning is limited. If many students from other classes show up, we'll need to accommodate a maximum of five students participating in the game at the same time."

"Let's follow the schedule we set up before. Everyone, remember your assigned times, and don't get carried away playing later."

Kong Junxiang was very confident in Li Luo's abilities. For school activities, he was basically a hands-off manager, leaving everything for Li Luo to organize, so he didn't need to worry.

Especially since Li Luo had high prestige in the class and was trusted by his classmates, unlike in some other classes where the class president's authority wasn't as high, many students were often unwilling to fully listen to them.

After almost a full semester together, Kong Junxiang was quite satisfied with Li Luo as the class president.

"Teacher Kong, is there anything else you need to add?" After instructing the students to get moving, Li Luo walked over to Kong Junxiang and asked.

"You can arrange it," Kong Junxiang said with a smile.

"Then would Teacher Kong like to try our class's mini-game first?" Li Luo picked up the guitar that was placed in the corner, looked at Kong Junxiang, and suggested with a smile, "Our classmates are very talented, you know."

"Sure, but there's one more person coming," Kong Junxiang said, and just then, a graceful figure peeked into the classroom from outside.

Teacher Ding, who taught English to Class Eight, tucked a loose strand of hair behind her ear and smiled at Kong Junxiang. Wearing a floral dress and high heels, she walked into Class Eight's classroom.

During the New Year's Day gala, since members of the student council were responsible for running the main activities, all teachers, except for those in charge like the dean of students, could participate in the various class mini-games just like the students.

However, some of the older teachers had participated many times before and mostly preferred to stay in their offices with the heat on.

Only young teachers like Kong Junxiang and Ding Xiang would have the interest to take part.

"Teacher Ding is here too."

Li Luo greeted Teacher Ding, then waved over at Yan Zhusheng. "Teacher Kong and Teacher Ding will be our first challengers. We can use this chance to test our process."

"Whoa," Zhang Guohuang hooted from the side, asking Kong Junxiang, "Teacher Kong, Teacher Li said he's lonely too. Why did you only ask Teacher Ding to play?"

"Teacher Li is already married," Teacher Ding said, smiling at Zhang Guohuang. "Zhang Guohuang, don't just stand there talking. I see you brought an instrument too, aren't you going to show us your skills?"

"Ahem, ahem... Teacher Ding, don't look at me like that. I'm scared."

"What's there to be scared of? It's not like we're in class." Teacher Ding beckoned to him. "Isn't it called 'Guess the Instrument'? How many of you are there?"

"There are nine performers in total," Li Luo explained from the side. "But only four will be here at a time. The challenge is that two of the four instruments will make a sound."

"It's a fifteen-second piece of music. After listening, you have to guess which two instruments they were."

"Guess correctly, and you pass."

"Let's do it." Kong Junxiang had already walked to the center of the classroom and, along with Ding Xiang, sat on the prepared chairs with their backs to the podium.

At the podium were Li Luo, Yan Zhusheng, Ren Zheng, and Zhang Guohuang.

The four of them held a guitar, a harmonica, a flute, and a trumpet, respectively.

The four looked at one another, pointing back and forth to decide which two would play.

In the end, it was decided that Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng would do it.

With guitar and harmonica together, they played the 15-second chorus of "The Sky Has No Limits."

After they finished, Kong Junxiang and Ding Xiang turned around.

"Let the teachers guess," Xiuxiu said, standing to the side and holding up the stamp in her hand. "If you guess correctly, you get a stamp."

The previous night, the school had distributed a stamp collection booklet.

There were sixteen empty slots in total, corresponding to the sixteen classes in one grade.

Upon completing a class's mini-game, one would receive the corresponding class's stamp.

If one managed to collect all 16 stamps within the allotted time in the morning, they could participate in a lottery event held by the student council.

"It seems quite simple, doesn't it?" Teacher Ding pondered for a moment, then pointed at Li Luo. "I can still recognize our class president's guitar."

"The other one was Yan Zhusheng," Kong Junxiang said. "It didn't sound like a flute or a trumpet."

"Congratulations, you're right," Xiuxiu said with a smile, walking over to stamp their booklets.

Zhu Yufei, watching from the side, immediately said, "So, did we make it too easy?"

"It's just a mini-game. There's no need to make it too hard," Kong Junxiang said. "I've participated in our school's New Year's gala for the past two years. Everyone mainly enjoys the feeling of collecting stamps and the atmosphere of playing together. It's no fun if the games are too difficult."

"Teacher Kong, where's your stamp booklet?" After stamping Teacher Ding's booklet, Xiuxiu noticed that Kong Junxiang didn't seem to have anything in his hands and asked curiously.

"I don't need one," Kong Junxiang coughed twice. "Just give Teacher Ding the stamp."

After Kong Junxiang gave a few more instructions and left the classroom with Teacher Ding, the students in the class all started snickering.

"Old Kong is making progress pretty fast."

"Think we'll get to see a little Kong before our college entrance exams?"

"I think Teacher Ding looks so pretty today. Ahhh! Kong Junxiang is so lucky!"

"Teacher Kong isn't bad either. I think he's really handsome. He and Teacher Ding look so perfect together."

Class Eight was now a group of little shippers, waiting all day for their head teacher and English teacher's wedding banquet.

Fuzhong No. 1 High School didn't prohibit relationships between colleagues, and anyone with eyes could more or less see the chemistry between Kong Junxiang and Ding Xiang.

Not that the two of them intended to hide it anyway. They were using the New Year's gala as an excuse to openly date at school, which could be called quite brazen.

"What is everyone talking about?" Only Yan Zhusheng was still a little lost. She turned her head to look at Li Luo. "What's going on with Teacher Kong and Teacher Ding?"

"It's nothing." Li Luo looked at Yan Zhusheng's confused little expression and felt a bit helpless. "It's fine if you don't understand."

"Is it a relationship where they can kiss?" Yan Zhusheng tilted her head and pressed on. "Like the main character and Mo Qinghan in your book..."

"Stop," Li Luo said with a straight face, cutting her off. "That topic is forbidden at school. You've broken the rule, Yan Zhusheng."

"Oh." Yan Zhusheng blinked. "Then punish me."

Li Luo: "...Why do I feel like you're enjoying this?"

"I'm not."

"That's what people usually say when they have a guilty conscience."

"Then I am."

"See, you admitted it."

Yan Zhusheng narrowed her eyes slightly. "Li Luo, you're bullying me."

"You're easier to bully."

Soon, it was eight o'clock.

As the bell rang and the broadcast reminded everyone that the activities had begun, the students without class duties poured out of their classrooms, walking down the hallways in groups with their good friends, heading towards other classes.

The entire Fuzhong No. 1 High School came alive with excitement. The school building buzzed with chatter, boiling with energy, even dispelling much of the winter's severe cold.

Li Luo didn't go out with them. During the eight to nine o'clock slot, he had to stay busy in the classroom.

He didn't know if it was his imagination, but he felt that of the students from other classes who came into the classroom, many of the girls were always glancing his way, while the boys often looked at Yan Zhusheng.

Especially the people lining up outside the classroom. When they had nothing to do, besides chatting with friends, they would peer through the windows, with most of their gazes falling on Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng.

"Why do I feel like they're looking at me?" During a break, Li Luo looked out the window curiously, only to see several girls laughing and playfully shoving each other, quickly averting their eyes.

"You don't know?" Ren Zheng said from the side. "Class President, you're really popular in school now."

"Huh?"

"But you don't care about this stuff, so it's normal that you don't know," Ren Zheng said with a sweet smile. "Back during the military training at the start of the school year, you sang on the field and bought us drinks and ice cream."

"Then at the sports meet, your rock band performed, and you also sang a song by yourself. A lot of girls noticed you."

"The girls in the dorms often talk about which boys in the first year are more popular. Your popularity is really high right now."

After hearing this, Li Luo subconsciously touched his own face. "For real?"

He hadn't felt it himself, but he never expected his reputation to be so well-known among the girls.

"Of course it's real," Xu Yinghuan chimed in from the side, adding enthusiastically, "But, many of them know about you and Zhusheng, so most of them have given up."

"What do you mean, my and Yan Zhusheng's relationship?" Li Luo said with a straight face and a righteous tone. "Comrade Xu Yinghuan, you'd better not spread false rumors in the girls' dormitory."

"It's not just me saying it," Xu Yinghuan muttered under her breath.

After busying himself in Class Eight's classroom for an hour, the time finally reached nine in the morning.

Li Luo swapped with Chen Zhongqi, who had come to take over, and then said to Yan Zhusheng, "Are you sure you want to stay in the classroom? If you want to go play somewhere else, I can find someone to cover for you."

Yan Zhusheng shook her head, her face full of interest, still immersed in the fun of playing instruments at will.

This time, she had brought several niche instruments. Most of the students who came to Class Eight for the mini-game guessed the instruments wrong, and they were basically tricked by Yan Zhusheng.

She always liked to pick an instrument with a timbre similar to others to play, and she was having a great time.

Seeing how happy Yan Zhusheng was, Li Luo left her be.

Just as he was considering whether to go upstairs to find Ying Chanxi, a beautiful figure at the door was already waving at him.

"Li Luo, let's go." Ying Chanxi peeked into Class Eight's classroom and called out to Li Luo.

(End of this chapter)
